context: LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE availability (live, mocker 0.7.2, ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev:latest, memsql 10.9.0, linux/amd64): server @@local_infile = ON by default. Driver singlestoredb 1.18.2: connect() without local_infile=True fails with error 1148 "LOAD DATA LOCAL is disabled by your client configuration"; with local_infile=True the load succeeds (2 rows, rowcount 2) and a trailing '|' is absorbed by an extra `@var` column-list entry, so no file staging is needed. SingleStoreAdapter._connect_database already passes local_infile=True. Mocker limits hit: `mocker compose up` of docker/singlestore fails with "Error: platform linux/arm64" (compose ignores `platform: linux/amd64`; make uat-bring-up PLATFORM=singlestore fails the same way even after `mocker pull --platform linux/amd64`), and the default 1 GiB VM makes memsql abort at start (globals.cpp:6384). Working bring-up: `mocker run -d --platform linux/amd64 -m 6g -c 4 --name benchbox-uat-manual-singlestore-singlestore-1 -p 13306:3306 -e ROOT_PASSWORD=benchbox ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev:latest`.
description: Follow-up to tpch-rf1-native-ingest-singlestore-20261103, which landed only a fallback pin (SingleStoreAdapter stays on INSERT ... VALUES) because the author host had no container runtime. On a host with Docker: (1) check LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE is accepted (server local_infile) and record it; (2) implement ingest_refresh_file on SingleStoreAdapter with supports_native_refresh_ingest declared on the class, inside the RF1 timer, no adapter.load_data, no mode moving work before the timer; (3) per-column checksum parity vs VALUES at SF0.01, atomicity with an injected bad row, RF1 SF1 duration vs VALUES; keep the fallback if not faster. Update the SingleStore row of the TPC measured-intervals reference. No live cloud.
